description: Removes a webhook endpoint. Statuser will stop sending events to it. To stop only some event types without deleting, use `webhook_update` and shrink the `subscriptions` list.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: webhook_delete
title: Delete webhook
